detailed_descriptions.en: NOT DEAD YET. THE BATTLE CONTINUES. Reignite your fighting spirit. A new battlefield awaits in the world of bullet hell shooters. CAVE's bullet hell shooter, DoDonPachi Resurrection, returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite. Overwhelming bullet patterns, intense battles of wits, and the sense of accomplishment that awaits beyond your limits— all the excitement remains, now joined by new features designed to support your next challenge, coming to Steam. 【FEATURES】 ■ New Mode: Shooting Royale A new kind of shooting battle where up to 10 players compete against each other. Use a variety of items and special weapons to take down your rivals. Survive until the end and claim first place in the Royale! ■ Assist Features for New and Returning Challengers New features designed to support players taking on a fresh challenge, from beginners to returning players. Enjoy the depth of bullet hell shooting in a way that suits your own playstyle. ■ New Stage: Stage 6 A new trial awaits. A brand-new stage, Stage 6, makes its debut, offering a challenge unlike anything before it. Break through the many obstacles that stand in your way and push beyond. ■ The Arcade Thrill and Systems, Just as You Remember Them Experience once again the beauty of meticulously designed bullet patterns and the exhilaration of weaving through them. Enjoy that same excitement and tension on Steam. Plus, new Daughters, new BGM, and more have been added. Experience DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite—the new battlefield awaits!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
NOT DEAD YET. THE BATTLE CONTINUES.

Reignite your fighting spirit. A new battlefield awaits in the world of bullet hell shooters.

CAVE's bullet hell shooter, DoDonPachi Resurrection, returns as DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite.

Overwhelming bullet patterns, intense battles of wits, and the sense of accomplishment that awaits beyond your limits—

all the excitement remains, now joined by new features designed to support your next challenge, coming to Steam.

【FEATURES】

■ New Mode: Shooting Royale

A new kind of shooting battle where up to 10 players compete against each other.

Use a variety of items and special weapons to take down your rivals.

Survive until the end and claim first place in the Royale!

■ Assist Features for New and Returning Challengers

New features designed to support players taking on a fresh challenge, from beginners to returning players.

Enjoy the depth of bullet hell shooting in a way that suits your own playstyle.

■ New Stage: Stage 6

A new trial awaits.

A brand-new stage, Stage 6, makes its debut, offering a challenge unlike anything before it.

Break through the many obstacles that stand in your way and push beyond.

■ The Arcade Thrill and Systems, Just as You Remember Them

Experience once again the beauty of meticulously designed bullet patterns and the exhilaration of weaving through them.

Enjoy that same excitement and tension on Steam.

Plus, new Daughters, new BGM, and more have been added.

Experience DoDonPachi Resurrection Reignite—the new battlefield awaits!
